All class sessions will be held from 1:00 to 2:15 PM in Room E321-323 on the third floor of the Robbins building at CWRU's School of Medicine.

Readings come from:

- **Spiegelhalter**: David Spiegelhalter's [The Art of Statistics: How to Learn from Data](https://www.amazon.com/Art-Statistics-How-Learn-Data/dp/1541675703) originally published in 2020 and available at all major book retailers.
- **R4DS**: R for Data Science (2nd edition), found at <https://r4ds.hadley.nz/>.
- **TEL**: Dr. Love's course book, entitled [Applied Statistics and R Foundations for 431](https://thomaselove.github.io/431-book/)

### Project B Presentation Scheduling

You will give your Project B presentation to Dr. Love (via Zoom or in person) on **one** of the four dates: Friday 2026-12-03, Monday 2026-12-07, Tuesday 2026-12-08, or Wednesday 2026-12-09. We will schedule these presentations in early November based on responses to the Project B registration form. Your time commitment on the day you are assigned will be no more than one hour long.

## TA Office Hours

TA Office Hours for 431 will begin on Sunday 2026-08-30 and continue through Tuesday 2026-12-08. 

- All TA Office Hours are held over Zoom. 
- Our [Shared Google Drive (431 Fall 2026 Dr Love and Students)](google.qmd) will display Zoom links for all TA office hours in a document called **431 TA office hours schedule and Zoom links**. 
- No appointment is necessary. Please just drop in.

DATE | TIME(S) (All times Eastern)
:--------: | :----------------------------------
Sundays | 1:00 - 2:00 PM, 5:30 - 8:30 PM
Mondays | 2:00 - 5:00 PM, 5:30 - 7:30 PM, 8:00 - 9:00 PM
Tuesdays | 9:00 - 10:00 PM
Wednesdays | none
Thursdays | 10:00 AM - Noon
Fridays | 10:00 AM - Noon, 12:30 - 2:30 PM, 3:00 - 5:00 PM
Saturdays | 10:00 AM - Noon, 6:00 - 8:00 PM

- 431 TA Office Hours are **cancelled** on Monday 2026-10-19 and Tuesday 2026–10-20 for Fall Break, and also **cancelled** from Saturday 2026-11-21 through Friday 2026-11-27 during Thanksgiving Week.
